subject: Vendor enrollment & MSA redlines — Ariba/Coupa onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sam Green <sam.green@medalign.com>, Emily Cho <emily.cho@medalign.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor enrollment & MSA redline - Ariba/Coupa requirements

Hi Sam / Emily —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. To keep momentum I wanted to summarize the enrollment and contract items we'll need to close before we can accept POs and enable auto-invoicing via your procurement systems. High level asks from our side: 

- Legal: Rishi will review the MSA + Order Form redlines (I attached the current Order Form draft).
- Procurement portal: confirm whether MedAlign will onboard us on Ariba Supplier Network or Coupa (or both) and whether you require cXML/EDI setup for POs/invoices.
- PO requirements: please confirm required fields (e.g., PO number format, remit-to instructions, Tax ID, vendor code), and whether a sample PO can be shared.
- Billing terms: propose net-30 on submitted invoices; if procurement requires different terms note that here.

Attachments: OrderForm_v1_for_redline.docx (attached).

Next steps I propose: once Sam confirms portal and PO sample, I'll escalate to Legal (Rishi) for a targeted redline turnaround this week. Lauren, looping you to confirm discount and commercial points.

Thanks — looking to align dates so onboarding + DocuSign signature completes before your planned pilot (target week of 12/14).

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

[Attachment: OrderForm_v1_for_redline.docx]

From: Sam Green <sam.green@medalign.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Emily Cho <emily.cho@medalign.com>
Cc: Procurement Portal (Ariba) <vendor-ops@ariba.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment & MSA redline - Ariba/Coupa requirements

Vanessa — thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- MedAlign uses Ariba SN for our central vendor management; a small subset of business units uses Coupa. For your account we'll start with Ariba.
- We can accept POs via cXML and EDI 850 depending on the BU. cXML is preferred for automation.
- I'll attach our internal portal guidance and a sample PO. You will need to provide: vendor legal name, Tax ID, remit-to address, and banking details for ACH.
- SOC2 report is usually requested for our security review; procurement portal will note that in the onboarding checklist.

Attached: MedAlign_vendor_requirements.pdf (portal checklist + sample PO).

I'll coordinate with vendor-ops@ariba.com to send the formal supplier invite once Redwood confirms the vendor legal name and the primary onboarding contact.

Sam Green
Senior Procurement Manager, MedAlign Health
sam.green@medalign.com
[Attachment: MedAlign_vendor_requirements.pdf]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Sam Green <sam.green@medalign.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Vendor enrollment & MSA redline - Ariba/Coupa requirements

Rishi — forwarding Sam's portal checklist. Can you prioritize a legal pass on the MSA and the attached Order Form? Key commercial items for negotiation we want to protect/confirm:

- Indemnity and limitation of liability caps on the MSA (customer requested broad carveouts).
- Data handling / customer data residency obligations (MedAlign mentions SOC2).
- PO acceptance: confirm that a PO via cXML (Ariba) constitutes an order acceptance and is sufficient for billing.
- Billing terms: we're proposing net-30; if procurement requires different SLA/penalty clauses, flag them.

Attached: OrderForm_v1_for_redline.docx (same doc as earlier). Our target is to have a redline back to Sam by 11/25 to keep the onboarding window open.

Thanks — Vanessa

Subject: Re: Fwd: Vendor enrollment & MSA redline - Ariba/Coupa requirements

Vanessa / Lauren —

Quick legal summary after initial pass: see attached MSA_redline_v2.docx (tracked changes). High-level items for commercial alignment:

1) Liability cap should remain tied to fees paid in 12 months (we can offer an exception if customer insists on a higher cap tied to the deal value; discuss offline).
2) Carve out for data breaches: propose contractual security language + requirement for SOC2 Type II attestation (we should provide our latest report).
3) PO acceptance: we can accept electronic POs (cXML) as binding orders provided procurement system includes PO number and accurate remit instructions. Add clause referencing accepted electronic ordering mechanisms.
4) Termination for convenience: limit to 30/60 day notice depending on business terms; consider negotiation if they insist on net-90 termination exposure.

Questions for operations: can Redwood accept PO acknowledgements via cXML and auto-invoice through Ariba? Vanessa, please confirm integrations / finance path so I can draft precise language around invoice submission and acceptance criteria.

Target: I'll return a clean PDF of our redline and a short negotiation memo by 11/25 EOD.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

[Attachment: MSA_redline_v2.docx]

From: Sam Green <sam.green@medalign.com>

Cc: Emily Cho <emily.cho@medalign.com>, Procurement Portal (Ariba) <vendor-ops@ariba.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment & MSA redline - Ariba/Coupa requirements

Rishi / Vanessa — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few operational details so Legal can finalize language: 

- Ariba: yes, we will issue the supplier invite once we have vendor legal name + remit details. Ariba supports cXML PO and we can enable automatic invoice reconciliation if Redwood posts invoice to Ariba.
- Required fields on PO: PO number, BU code, line-level description, unit price, tax lines (if any), ship-to (if applicable), remit-to (billing). Our sample PO includes the fields (attached previously).
- Tax ID (EIN): 12-3456789 (for testing only; final validation during registration).
- Go-live: our onboarding slot is open the week of 12/13 if signatures and vendor setup complete by 12/10.

We can also accept a DocuSign envelope (please send the link) and a final redline PDF.

Sam
